```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,  # covers dplyr, ggplot2, lubridate, tidyr, stringr, purrr, forcats
  statmod, tweedie,
  glue, broom
)
```

```{r}
test <- read.csv("data/test.csv")
p <- readRDS("tweedie_p_final.rds")
model_final <- readRDS("model_final.rds")
```

```{r}
formula(model_final)
```

```{r}
# Top 24 outlier breeds identified in 3.eda.Rmd dumbbell plot
surcharge_breeds <- c(
  "Poodle", "Airedale Terrier", "Afghan Hound", "Bull Terrier", "Chausie",
  "Kerry Blue Terrier", "Welsh Springer Spaniel", "Chow Chow", 
  "Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier", "American Staffordshire Terrier", "Pointer", 
  "Polish Lowland Sheepdog", "Collie", "Staffordshire Bull Terrier", 
  "Black and Tan Coonhound", "Dalmatian"
)

discount_breeds <- c(
  "Australian Terrier", "Pumi", "Shetland Sheepdog", "Beagle", 
  "Pyrenean Shepherd", "Pembroke Welsh Corgi", "Rat Terrier", "Norfolk Terrier"
)
cat_cols <- c("policy.NBRB","pet.Type",
              "pet.Group","pet.Breed","pet.Gender","pet.Offspring","pet.Microchip","pet.Origin",
              "owner.Gender","owner.Location","owner.Channel"
              )
test <- test |> 
  mutate(across(all_of(cat_cols), factor)) |> 
  mutate(
    pet.Type = relevel(pet.Type, ref = "Dog"),
    pet.Group = relevel(pet.Group, ref = "Shorthair"),
    pet.Gender = relevel(pet.Gender, ref = "Male"),
    pet.Offspring = relevel(pet.Offspring, ref = "No"),
    pet.Microchip = relevel(pet.Microchip, ref = "Yes"),
    pet.Origin = relevel(pet.Origin, ref = "Store"),
    pet.Origin = relevel(pet.Origin, ref = "Store"),
    owner.Gender = relevel(owner.Gender, ref = "Male"),
    owner.Location = relevel(owner.Location, ref = "Suburban"),
    policy.NBRB = relevel(policy.NBRB, ref = "RB"),
    breed_outlier = factor(
      case_when(
        pet.Breed %in% surcharge_breeds ~ "Surcharge",
        pet.Breed %in% discount_breeds  ~ "Discount",
        TRUE ~ "Standard"
      ),
      levels = c("Standard", "Surcharge", "Discount")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
test <- test |> 
  mutate(
    predicted_losses = predict(model_final, newdata = test, type = "response"),
    predicted_pp = predicted_losses / policy.Exposure
  )
```

```{r}
test |> 
  summarize(
    mean_actual_pp = round(mean(pure_premium), 2),
    mean_predicted_pp = round(mean(predicted_pp),2),
    ratio = round(mean(pure_premium)/mean(predicted_pp), 4)
  )
```

# Double Life Curve

```{r}
benchmark_pp <- mean(test$pure_premium)

test <- test |> 
  mutate(
    lift_ratio = predicted_pp / benchmark_pp,
    decile = ntile(lift_ratio, 10)
  )
```

```{r}
double_lift <- test |> 
  group_by(decile) |> 
  summarize(
    n_policies = n(),
    mean_actual_pp = round(mean(pure_premium), 2),
    mean_predicted_pp = round(mean(predicted_pp), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(double_lift)
```
```{r}
double_lift |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_actual_pp, mean_predicted_pp),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "pure_premium"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      type == "mean_actual_pp" ~ "Actual",
      type == "mean_predicted_pp" ~ "Predicted"
    )
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = decile, y = pure_premium, color = type, group = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "steelblue", "Predicted" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(
    title = "Double Lift Curve",
    subtitle = "Policies sorted by predicted-to-benchmark ratio and grouped into deciles",
    x = "Decile (1 = Lowest Predicted Risk, 10 = Highest Predicted Risk)",
    y = "Mean Pure Premium ($)",
    color = NULL
  ) + theme_minimal()

```
# Gini Coefficient

```{r}
gini_data <- test |> 
  arrange(predicted_pp) |> 
  mutate(
    cumulative_exposure = cumsum(policy.Exposure) / sum(policy.Exposure),
    cumulative_losses = cumsum(total_losses) / sum(total_losses)
  )

gini_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = cumulative_exposure, y = cumulative_losses)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Lorenz Curve - Cumualtive Loss Share vs Cumulative Exposure Share",
    x = "Cumulative Exopsure Share",
    y = "Cumulative Loss Share"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
n <- nrow(gini_data)
gini_area <- sum(
  (gini_data$cumulative_exposure[2:n] - gini_data$cumulative_exposure[1:(n-1)]) *
  (gini_data$cumulative_losses[2:n] + gini_data$cumulative_losses[1:(n-1)]) / 2
)

gini_coef <- 1 - 2 * gini_area

glue("Gini Coefficient: {round(gini_coef, 4)}")
```
Since, gini > 0.4, it's a quite strong relationship. This model has a strong discrimination power.

# Out-of-Sample Loss Ratios by Decile

```{r}
test <- test |> 
  mutate(decile_pp = ntile(predicted_pp, 10))
```

```{r}
loss_ratio_table <- test |>
  group_by(decile_pp) |> 
  summarize(
    n_policies = n(),
    total_actual = round(sum(total_losses), 0),
    total_predcited = round(sum(predicted_losses), 0),
    loss_ratio = round(sum(total_losses)/sum(predicted_losses), 3),
    mean_actual_pp = round(mean(pure_premium), 2),
    mean_predicted_pp = round(mean(predicted_pp), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(loss_ratio_table)
```
```{r}
loss_ratio_table |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = decile_pp, y = loss_ratio)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10)+
  labs(
    title = "Out-of-sample Loss Ratios by Predicted Pure Premium Decile",
    subtitle = "Loss ratio = actual losses / predicted losses. Values near 1.0 indicate good calibration.",
    x = "Decile (1 = Lowest Predicted, 10 = Highest Predicted)",
    y = "Loss Ratio"
  ) + theme_minimal()

```
